C0851.title: Microsoft Discloses Large-Scale Credential Phishing Campaign Targeting Global Organizations
C0851.summary: Microsoft Defender Research disclosed that it observed a series of multi-stage, code-of-conduct-themed phishing campaigns between April 14 and 16, 2026. The attackers sent fully authenticated emails from attacker-controlled domains through legitimate email services, affecting more than 35,000 users across over 13,000 organizations in 26 countries, and ultimately routed users into an AiTM phishing flow designed to capture authentication tokens and compromise accounts.
